prose.name: Bounty: Cattle Thief on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A stockwoman at the <Place> is losing cattle at night, two a week, to raiders who drive them up to their boss. She has asked for someone to come and see her.

beats.objective: Talk to the stockwoman at the <Place>
beats.journal: A stockwoman at the <Place> is losing two head of cattle a week to raiders, who drive them to their boss at the <SecondPlace>. She asked me to deal with him.

person.name: Maura Ketley
person._outfit: 11a's farmer outfit, already worn in game. His eye decides.
hellos: You'll be the one who answered the call.

greeting: Raiders have been taking my cattle. They come at night, take two at a time, and drive them up to their boss. He's eating them.

reply: Do that. His crew only take what he tells them to. Stop him, and it stops.
Eleven since the thaw. The last was a four-year-old cow. Five hundred kilos, and in calf. She had eight good years left.

exchanges.prompt: Is there a price on him?
reply: Not that I know of. If there is, it's yours. I just want my cattle left alone.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 closes the talk and starts the defeat. Every prompt asks about something the greeting has already said (the boss, the losses). Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency. Pass 2026-10-23, his "unclear shes talking about cows and doesn't read well spoken": she says cattle in her first sentence, the stock is driven, not carried, and the long one-breath replies are split at their real pauses.

say: Is it done? Then I'll count them in tonight, and for once it'll be the same number as this morning.

broadcast: Someone's stealing my cattle. Two a week, always at night. I know where they're taking them. Come and see me, and I'll tell you the rest.
